crossRefs.note: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any…
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…

translations.web: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
translations.bsb: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
translations.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
translations.asv: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;
